attachments.insertion_landmark: medial border of scapula, at the root of the spine

actions: retracts and downwardly rotates the scapula

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Smaller and more superior than rhomboid major, sometimes fused with it as a single continuous sheet -- a documented anatomical variant.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)
